name: Cap de Formentor Loop
description: The lighthouse road. Out along the Formentor peninsula to the lighthouse at Mallorca's north-eastern tip. Exposed coastal riding with dramatic cliffs and switchbacks.

name: Puerto Pollensa to Sa Calobra Loop
description: 103km including the famous Sa Calobra descent and return climb — 26 hairpins, 10km, and a canyon at the bottom. The pilgrimage route.

name: Alcudia to Sa Calobra
description: Shorter approach to Sa Calobra from the Alcudia side. Through Pollensa, over the Coll de Sa Batalla, and down the snake road to the cove.

name: Cap Formentor from Alcudia
description: Cap de Formentor loop starting from Alcudia. Out along the peninsula to the lighthouse with views across to Menorca on clear days.

name: Inca to Sa Calobra via Cap Formentor
description: The big Mallorca day — Sa Calobra AND Cap de Formentor in one ride from Inca. 155km and 3,000m of climbing. When you're done, you're done.

name: Mallorca 95km Formentor via Sa Pobla
description: Interior approach to Cap de Formentor via the flat agricultural roads through Sa Pobla and Muro. Good balance of flat training terrain and a coastal payoff.
